The '''Celestial Record''' should have been an artifact describing the coming of the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] and giving intelligence and wisdom to the [[First Duchess]]. This story was largely ignored by the [[Drall/Legends|Dralls]].
